summary: Tested /api/connect email flow + persistence + branding + /contact UI + popup. Endpoint returns 200 and correctly persists inquiries with source field. HOWEVER: (1) Frontend ContactPage.js is MISSING `source:'contact page'` in the axios payload — contact-page submissions are stored with source='' AND the branded email subject uses the wrong label ('Private Inquiry popup' fallback). (2) Resend proxy is currently returning 422 'Undeliverable recipient' for JamesAGreen@eXpRealty.com — an external deliverability block by Resend after the initial 202 send earlier. Endpoint gracefully returns email_sent:false. Email template code, branding palette, _assert_safe_email gate, escape() usage, no forms in template, all HTTPS — all correctly implemented in server.py. Popup sends source:'popup' correctly, close button works, /contact shows only email + phone (no 'Office:' text), both links correct (mailto/tel). No console errors on /contact.

minor.issue: Resend proxy currently returning 422 'undeliverable_recipient' for OWNER_EMAIL JamesAGreen@eXpRealty.com. Backend gracefully returns email_sent:false. External Resend deliverability block; verified server code and payload are correct (initial 202 recorded at 16:44:26 UTC in supervisor log for the manual curl). Not a code bug — may require Resend dashboard/domain-verification action, or waiting for the deliverability cool-down. Consider adding retry/backoff and surfacing this via logs.

ui_bugs.issue: Payload to POST /api/connect does NOT include `source: 'contact page'`. Captured network payload: {"firstName":"UITest","lastName":"User","email":"...","phone":"...","dreNumber":"","message":"","interests":["Buying"],"consent":true} — no `source` key. Result: DB records from the /contact form are saved with source='' and the branded email subject line label falls into the 'Private Inquiry popup' branch on the server (source_label ternary in server.py:264 treats anything != 'contact page' as popup). Add `source: 'contact page'` to the axios.post body.

action_items: FIX (high): In /app/frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.js submit(), add `source: 'contact page'` to the axios.post body so DB records + email subject correctly identify contact-page inquiries.

INVESTIGATE (external): Resend integrations proxy is returning 422 undeliverable_recipient for JamesAGreen@eXpRealty.com. First send worked (202), subsequent sends blocked. Likely Resend recipient-suppression list or domain-verification issue. Since email_sent may frequently be false, consider: (a) logging body to server for durability, (b) surfacing email_sent status to user or admin, or (c) verifying/whitelisting recipient in Resend. Not a code bug in server.py — verified endpoint calls send_email correctly and gracefully handles failures.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactPage.js: form.interest is a single string but is sent as `interests: [form.interest]` — OK, but no `source` field passed → server stores source='' and email mis-labels.
server.py: `source_label` ternary treats any non-'contact page' string (including empty) as 'Private Inquiry popup' — brittle, prefer explicit mapping and reject unknown source values.

server.py: send_email raises HTTPException on failure which is caught (try/except Exception) in /api/connect — correct graceful degradation. Consider logging inquiry.id in the except so failed email deliveries can be reconciled.
server.py properties: SAMPLE_PROPERTIES uses `Property(...)` instantiation with hard-coded fields; fine for now.
OWNER_EMAIL is correctly server-controlled (never caller-supplied) — G4 compliance ✅.
Email template: no <form>/<input>, all interpolations escape()'d, palette colors match spec (#16100C/#221810/#A8926E/#F1E6D7), _assert_safe_email invoked on every send ✅.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds `source: 'contact page'` to ContactPage.js payload, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_connect_email.py + a fresh Playwright network-intercept on /contact submit to confirm the outgoing payload now contains `source:'contact page'`. Note: email_sent:false is expected right now due to Resend's temporary undeliverable_recipient block on JamesAGreen@eXpRealty.com; that is NOT a code regression — verify by checking supervisor logs for 422 vs 202. If email_sent must be True in tests, either (a) verify recipient in Resend dashboard, or (b) temporarily set OWNER_EMAIL=delivered@resend.dev per Resend's testing guidance.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA #1 (ContactPage source missing): ContactPage.js was updated to include `source: 'contact page'` per the review request but the submit() function's axios.post payload object does not contain that key (verified via Playwright request-interception). Reproduction: submit /contact form → inspect network POST body → source key absent. Fix: add `source: 'contact page'` alongside the other fields in the payload. RCA #2 (email_sent false): Resend integrations proxy returned 202 for the very first send (owner manual test at 16:44 UTC) then repeatedly returned 422 'Recipient looks undeliverable and was blocked before sending to protect deliverability' for subsequent sends to JamesAGreen@eXpRealty.com. This is a Resend recipient-suppression / deliverability filter (external service). Backend correctly wraps failure and returns email_sent:false. Mitigation: verify recipient in Resend or wait for suppression cool-down.
